prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game background for Moonlight Merchant. Input image 1 is an ART DIRECTION REFERENCE ONLY: match its gorgeous cozy pixel art, walnut timber, antique gold, plum shadows and moonlit blue light. Generate a NEW background without any UI or characters.
Output: landscape 4:3 composition, ideally 1600x1200. Orthographic slightly elevated top-down shop interior, no vanishing point distortion. Artwork extends to edges, no decorative exterior frame.
Precise layout in an 800x600 logical canvas: rear wall occupies y=0..145, a moonlit central window at x=320..480 y=20..120, hanging amber lamps and trailing plants toward corners. Exactly five EMPTY small wooden merchandise shelving units arranged horizontally: centers x=136,268,400,532,664. All five span y=150..300, each 104px wide, with open empty interiors where separate item sprites will be rendered at y=194..270. Make the top and bottom horizontal shelf ledges at y=184 and y=270; interiors must stay dark and uncluttered. Each unit is separate from its neighbors. Absolutely NO goods baked onto these five display shelves: no potions, swords, mushrooms or herbs on them. They must truthfully look empty.
Floor occupies y=300..600, detailed mellow walnut boards, a plum rug with a subtle gold crescent at x=240..540 y=370..490. Keep floor between x=80..720 y=320..550 clear for characters. A small sales desk on right at x=650..790 y=405..475, with purple cloth, open ledger, quill, brass bell. No person behind desk; shopkeeper sprite added separately. Sparse plants, books, one globe, crates in bottom outer corners only. Entrance centered at x=400 y=570, leaving a clear walking aisle to each shelf.
Medium: meticulously clustered crisp pixel art, same charm as the reference, limited harmonious colors, warm lamps against cool night window, subtle textile patterns and brass details. No lettering, labels, price tags, HUD, menus, watermarks, human figures, shadows of people, or products on merchandise shelves. This is a usable background layer, not a screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG character atlas for Moonlight Merchant.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY. Match its crisp detailed chibi pixel art, appealing readable faces, walnut/plum/gold fantasy world. Generate six distinct isolated full-body character sprites in a STRICT 3-column by 2-row uniform grid, landscape canvas ideally 1536x1024, six exactly equal square cells. TRANSPARENT background everywhere outside sprites, no checkerboard painted into image, no text, no cell frames. Each character fits completely within its own cell with transparent padding at least 12% of the cell on all sides, feet aligned at 86% cell height, bodies centered at cell center. Similar visual height and 2.8-head body proportions. All standing in a gentle three-quarter FRONT view facing slightly left. No props spilling to adjacent cells. Boots visible and anatomically clear silhouettes. Small flat oval ground contact shadow can be subtle translucent, no large cast shadows.
Order is mandatory:
top left: Luna, apprentice mage, silver bobbed hair, large violet pointed hat with brass buckle and tiny stars, violet short cape, brown travel satchel, happy inquisitive expression, matches reference visiting mage.
top center: Rowen, young male adventurer, short brown hair, forest green cape, red scarf, leather vest and boots, small belt pouch, confident smile.
top right: Theo, novice knight, blond hair, silver and muted blue armor, blue cape, small sheathed sword, friendly earnest face, NO full face covering.
bottom left: Mira, female herbalist, auburn braid, moss green hood folded back, cream blouse and brown skirt, small woven harvest basket, cheerful face.
bottom center: Selene, adult female mage, long dark teal hair, midnight blue and purple robe, golden crescent brooch, modest small wooden staff with blue crystal, calm expression.
bottom right: the shopkeeper, young adult woman, dark hair in loose bun, teal apron with gold crescent over cream puff-sleeve blouse, brown skirt, warm welcoming smile, hands naturally held in front.
All SIX must be game scale pixel sprite designs, not large smooth anime illustrations, no 3D, no background shop, no UI, no words, exactly one character per cell. Preserve alpha transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG item and menu icon atlas for Moonlight Merchant.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, match its richly detailed crisp pixel art inventory objects, warm brass highlights, walnut and plum colors. Generate exactly TWELVE isolated pixel-art icons in a STRICT 4 columns x 3 rows evenly spaced uniform square grid, canvas 1536x1152 ideally, four columns mandatory. Transparent background; no painted checkerboard, no lettering, no labels, no tile outlines or opaque backing. Each icon centered in its cell, fits within central 72% of cell, ample empty transparent margins and absolutely no overlap. All icons crisp recognisable pixel art with consistent outline weight, soft highlight clusters and bounded contact shadows, no glows extending into other cells.
Order left to right then top to bottom MUST be:
row1 col1: tied bundle of fresh green medicinal herbs with a few tiny flowers.
row1 col2: rounded red healing potion bottle, cork stopper and antique brass neck.
row1 col3: upright iron sword with silver blade, brass crossguard and brown leather grip.
row1 col4: a small violet moonlit mushroom cluster with pale stems.
row2 col1: rounded sapphire blue mana potion bottle with cork and brass neck.
row2 col2: walnut merchandise crate filled with herbs and one red potion, shop goods menu icon.
row2 col3: small alchemy mortar and blue glass flask, crafting menu icon.
row2 col4: parchment checklist with quill, preparation menu icon.
row3 col1: curled quest scroll tied with crimson seal, quest menu icon.
row3 col2: blacksmith hammer beside small timber shop roof, shop upgrade menu icon.
row3 col3: closed purple ledger book with brass corners and two gold coins, ledger menu icon.
row3 col4: ornate gold crescent moon medallion with a tiny star, brand icon.
No extra icons, no frames, no text, no characters, no scene. This must be a usable sprite atlas; preserve real alpha transparency.
